title: LineageOS GSI on Xiaomi 11T Pro Android 11 Install Guide

video_description:
LineageOS as a GSI on the Xiaomi 11T Pro — Android 11, the September security patches, and the fix in this build that finally kills the random livelock freezes.

Lineage on a GSI is a different animal from a device-specific build, and it's the version I keep coming back to when a phone starts feeling slow. Everything is generic on purpose, which means it's light, predictable, and boring in the best way.

📱 Device  : Xiaomi 11T Pro
🧩 ROM     : LineageOS (GSI, phh-treble)
🤖 Android : 11

🔧 What's In This Build
• September security patches merged in.
• Updated to the latest phh sources.
• llkd, the livelock daemon, removed — the real potential fix for those random freezes that used to hit some setups.

🛠️ What You Need
• An unlocked bootloader and a Treble-ready phone
• The LineageOS GSI image — all architectures are published for this one
• Vanilla only. There's no GApps build, so flash Google apps separately if you need them.
• The vbmeta file and platform tools on your PC

📝 Steps
1. fastboot reboot fastboot
2. fastboot --disable-verity --disable-verification flash vbmeta
3. fastboot erase system
4. fastboot flash system
5. fastboot reboot recovery
6. Wipe data in Mi Recovery
7. Reboot and you're in

Known bugs: nothing listed in the ROM itself. On the device side it depends on your vendor and kernel, same as every GSI. SELinux works both ways — enforcing and permissive.

📊 Verdict
If you want the cleanest, least dramatic Android experience on a Treble phone, this is it. No bloat, no theming circus, and the llkd removal is exactly the kind of fix that matters months later when a phone would otherwise start freezing at random. The catch is hardware: camera and any vendor-specific extras are your phone's problem, not Lineage's. And since it's vanilla, expect to spend ten extra minutes getting Google services in.
